name: Baal Gad
overview: Baal Gad is identified in Scripture as a city of the Canaanites located in the valley of Lebanon near Mount Hermon, often considered synonymous with Baal-Hermon. The passages in Joshua highlight its geographical significance as a boundary marker for the territories conquered by Israel under Joshua’s leadership, stretching from Mount Halak to Baal Gad. Judges 3:3 further situates Baal Gad within the context of the peoples dwelling in the region of Mount Lebanon, emphasizing its role in the broader narrative of Israel’s settlement and the surrounding nations.
